column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land No. 9 of Block 03, contained
in the Cadastral Map No. 320294, situated in the Village of Kadawalamadiththa within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 276 - Gu-
rudeniya  East  in  the  Divisional  Secretary's  Division  of  Kandy  Kadawath  Hathara  and  Four  Gravets,  in  the  District  of  Kandy,  in  the
Province of Central, referred to in Notice No. 32/0421 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No.
1787/11 of 03rd December, 2012 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
